notes.title: Update Notes for July 14, 2025
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug with older gamepads
 You should no longer be able to get "stuck" due to traffic in the NE corner of New Orleans

notes.title: Update Notes for June 18
notes.notes:
Did a little streamlining here and there to hopefully smooth over a few rough spots in combat:
 * Added a brief tutorial message to introduce the "Cleanse" spell in Nazca
 * Placed a Scroll of Freeze in Alexandria
 * Gave the whalebones in Point Hope a regular attack but reduced the frequency of spin attacks

Also fixed several text issues/typos!

notes.title: Patch Notes for May 30
notes.notes:
A few small bug fixes:

 Fixed a camera issue in a late game scene
 Prevent players from using Continental Breakfast when everyone is at max HP
 A handful of typo fixes

notes.title: Update Notes for 4/13/25
notes.notes: Latest patch has some minor bug and typo fixes.  Cats should no longer be able to block the western path in Aoshima.

notes.title: Update Notes for 3/29/25
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue that could cause a missing line of dialog in Newcastle
Aji de gallina now heals the proper amount of HP
Renamed all the songs played by the piano to match the upcoming OST release
Allowed cancellation of a selection in the language quiz
MATK/MDEF will now show up for all characters in the equip menu once any party member has learned magic
Buffed XP and ImagiDust levels for all monsters in Roter Kamm
Fixed a typo in the Point Hope Heritage Center
Fixed a bug in Kiwi Springs that could result in Drake being frozen in "shock face"

notes.title: Demo Update Announcement
notes.notes:
As we continue making steady progress with Geo Mythica, we felt it was time to release an updated demo. This includes new features, improvements and fresh content! 

So whether you played it a while ago or haven’t downloaded it yet, now’s the perfect time to dig in.

What’s New in the Demo?

Bug fixes aside, we added content and quality of life features that not only improves the experience, but extends game play a little too. Here’s a snapshot of what we’ve done.

Atlas Menu: With the Atlas menu, you can now keep track of collectible items you’ve found in each location, helping you identify anything you may have missed on your journey.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44575597/49532d71f869477965a6cd0d13ac868b66eb7234.png

The Frog of Completion: Whenever you collect all items in a specific location, the Frog of Completion in Mexico rewards you with a permanent stat boost for the character you choose!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44575597/e334a5e460c839ae7898c7b57ef915049ad1d809.png

Updated Narrative Content: The first dungeon has additional content which sets up the overarching narrative better while getting you familiar with new strategies to use on your adventure.

PLEASE NOTE: In light of the latter, we want to call out that you won’t be able to use any save states made before beating the first area (San Luis Obispo).

This should have minimal impact as it takes approximately 15 to 25 minutes to complete the first area.

More News on the Horizon

As we continue to refine Geo Mythica, we’re preparing for a limited open beta playtest.

So stay tuned for more details soon on how you can help us shape the final experience of Geo Mythica.

Until then, have fun with the new demo!

What else?

In addition to the demo update, Geo Mythica will also be attending a couple of events we highly encourage you to check out and share with your friends.

Be a Hero event hosted on Steam presented by Comic-Con Stuttgart is happening now until December 6th.  Showcasing lots of games featuring heroes going on a variety of adventures, we were honored to be part of the line up in this exciting event.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44575597/e3461c2f26c0fd8edd1bc64d5586cd2714eb75aa.png

MAGFest has graciously allowed us to exhibit the game once more. The team is eager to get back to the showroom floor to meet old friends, make new ones and share more updates and progress with Geo Mythica.

If you plan on attending, stop by and say hi. There may be something in it for you if you do ;)

That’s it for now, until next time… keep on adventuring!
- Chris
